fixed_target.status: Earlier Norbert proposal, including literal double E in BEEURTEILT; fixed solely for conditional comparison.

scope.native: All monotone injections of the 214 native slots into 224 model slots. Exactly 10 added slots, no deletion or movement; all 204 observed coordinates retained.
scope.one_printed_mask_exclusion: Each of the 10 printed masks may be excluded once; the remaining 213 native slots are injected monotonically into 224 slots with exactly 11 additions. No observed coordinate may be deleted or reordered.
scope.objective: Minimize observed-coordinate substitutions only. Every surviving printed mask and added slot is filled from the fixed complete target; their separate counts remain explicit.

novelty_check.existing_scope: Declared prior block repairs and five positions inside the short GAVD group. No all-monotone ten/eleven-insertion lower bound was present.
novelty_check.new_contribution: Exact lower bounds, optimal-map counts and attaining witnesses over the explicitly larger source-retaining alignment families.

limits: These are exact bounds conditioned on the fixed earlier 112-position wording and unchanged key, not proof that the wording or any missing-slot map is historical.
The target uses only assigned square cells. All 120 injective completions of the missing digits 5–9 yield identical target ciphertext; no independent per-position wildcard assignment is used.
Only a printed mask can be excluded in the second family. The final mask is the unique exclusion attaining the family minimum; this is not independent evidence that the printed mark is extraneous.
EINGELEITET and other alternative word proposals are unselected and outside this certificate.
